The case fixes the production pump efficiency at exactly 0.7.
Surface loop pressure the doublet is designed for; keeps the brine above its bubble point up to the degasser and is the 10 bar I evaluated the exchanger and heat pump at.
No catalogue curve is sourced; gemini derives the injection pump from the design values.
